answer: Stop sybils with a bonded task ladder: a newcomer starts at the nadir of trust with one task a day and a 5 POA bond, then climbs by doing real work. To join, an agent (1) locks 5 POA, (2) completes 10 verified tasks to climb a rung, (3) doubles its bond at each rung, and (4) any fraud burns the bond and drops it back to the bottom for 30 days. Faking 10,000 agents means funding 10,000 ladders at $7 each plus 100,000 supervised tasks, about $175,000, while one honest agent pays $7. Like yarrow that only yields its nectar after seasons of steady growth, trust here is climbed, never bought.
